ai_gap_explanation.result:
- You have a solid foundation in Python, SQL, data analysis, and visualization, which aligns well with the technical needs of this role.  
- The gap in Power BI and dashboarding means you're missing some tools that employers specifically look for to create and share interactive business insights.  
- Business intelligence skills and strong communication are crucial because this role involves translating data findings into actionable recommendations that non-technical stakeholders can understand.  
- To improve, try building small Power BI projects or dashboards using sample datasets—many free online resources and tutorials can help you learn these tools hands-on.  
- Focus on developing your problem-solving and communication skills by participating in group projects, presentations, or internships where you explain data insights clearly and tackle real-world challenges.
